features: Character TF-IDF of line and neighbors, normalized OCR geometry and text shape.
note: Line scores use transferred reference labels; final field scores use document annotations. All decoder choices use validation only.

calibration.method: sigmoid; three document-group folds within training, ensemble=False

selection.criterion: Highest combined validation macro field F1; test scores are not used for model selection.
selection.reason: Baseline has the highest SROIE validation macro F1; a separate general model exposes the broader-data tradeoff.

definitions.sroie_text: Casefold and collapse whitespace; punctuation retained.
definitions.wildreceipt_text: Casefold and remove whitespace; upstream box transcriptions omit internal spaces. Compare changes within a source.
definitions.date: Day-first if ambiguous. Ambiguous numeric WildReceipt date annotations are masked; a unique parseable annotation is required.
definitions.unknown_annotations: Fields with conflicting parseable values or no parseable value are excluded from scoring, rather than treated as correct nulls. A unique parsed value is kept if other copies cannot be parsed. Missing value annotations denote absence.
definitions.precision_recall: TP = correct non-null field. Wrong non-null adds FP and FN when truth exists. F1 is harmonic mean; zero denominator gives 0.
definitions.macro_f1: Unweighted mean of the four field F1 values. Combined results pool documents with source-specific matching/masks; they are not the mean of source F1.
definitions.timing: Wall-clock extraction time on CPU, after loading the model. Cached OCR times are separate; WildReceipt OCR used four concurrent workers with OMP_THREAD_LIMIT=1, so per-receipt timings are not directly comparable with serial SROIE OCR.
definitions.calibration: Sigmoid calibration uses out-of-fold training receipts; the complete feature pipeline is refit within each fold. Line probabilities are not the probability that an entire field string is correct.
